Recorded claim:
In the D330263 Toggle story, the review found a text input with no label, title, or accessible name. Storybook includes an accessibility check, so this field needs a name. This was a source finding only: Storybook was not run because its node_modules directory was absent.

Provenance: 9e713face177ad734eee4d7bf40224dfe4691362175b9cdf053484e7b93ac4ce. Original evidence IDs: 332cb962f0e06c7489e91320a7d7d64fbc0802b939924b6f850a5db353887481.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
